prose: Shares of US tech giants led the market higher Wednesday after the Democratic midterm sweep, as investors bet a Democrat-controlled Congress will slow AI capex that is draining cash flow, per Bloomberg. It contrasts with the AI-infrastructure names that fell on data-center risk.
highlights: Big Tech shares rose after the sweep on bets AI capex will slow
Investors treat slower spending as good for cash flow, per Bloomberg
